The '''Frithia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Glythe sector/Legends|Glythe sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Frithia]].
